svg.text: For a century the cost of bidding stood over the market and shaded out everyone who could not afford to grow under it.
Then AI made the call nearly free.
an estimating department, a bonding line,
the patience to lose five bids in six
A few large bidders grew in its shade.
The buyer's systems grew in the shade too, built for a few bids and time to read them.
The clearing fills with a thicket racing for the new sunlight.
Every seedling looks much like the next.
the forest floor: what this work has cost before, which no bid-writing bot can polish
The oak will not grow back. The question is who gets the light.
